Patient Intake Assessment Note
Date: 2024-03-12
Chief Complaint: Severe persistent low mood, loss of interest, feelings of worthlessness

Patient narrative:
"I haven't left my room in days. I feel completely empty and worthless. Nothing brings me joy anymore. I used to love painting and reading, but now everything feels pointless. I keep thinking about disappearing and not existing anymore. I can't sleep, can't eat, and I cried for most of yesterday afternoon without knowing why. The tiredness is overwhelming; even brushing my teeth feels impossible."

Clinician Observation:
Affect is blunted. Speech is slow with increased latency. Reports overwhelming exhaustion and inability to concentrate.
